what: One fixed vocabulary for every footage scene of any brand, keyed to the marketing doctrine's section ids (components/marketing-doctrine/ad-frameworks.json). A storyboard scene names a value for each descriptor; that row is the blank the library fills. Brand words live in the brand file, never here; '{brand_device}' stands for the brand's own product names.

beat.what: Which doctrine section this picture can carry. Ids are the doctrine's own section ids.

problem.means: The skin problem visible: acne, bumps, dark marks, oily or dry skin, a man inspecting it.

failed-solutions.means: The old way: bare hands, a rag, a razor, other products, frustration.

mechanism.means: The device or product working on skin: FLEX on the face, foam, bristles, lather.

routine.means: Applying the rest of the set: wash, PRIME, CRUSH, serum, towel dry.

product.means: The product itself: in hand to camera, on a surface, box, unboxing, charging.
product.brand_words: the brand's product match words are added to this group at load

transformation.means: The after: clear skin, touching his face, confident in the mirror, a reveal.

proof.means: Evidence: a before and after, a result shown, a reaction, a review on screen.

identification.means: The viewer's world, no product: barber chair, getting ready, street, car, gym, his day.

presence.means: A man on screen with no product and no task: looks to camera, smiles, poses, walks in. Carries identification or the after.

presenter.means: A person talking to camera. Fills testimonial and story beats through the presenter route, never as b-roll.
presenter.rule: clip talking_head is true and the scene has speech

values.hands: only hands or a body part

tier.what: Picture quality only (owner ruling 2026-11-06). Text is its own descriptor, text_marks.

values.A: Direct b-roll. Checked clips: polish studio-staged or hucg, short side 720 px or more, no quality problem seen, scene 2 s or longer, not a talking head. Unchecked clips: short side 1080 px or more and no quality note.
values.B: Montage or proof only: phone UGC, screen recording, AI or animation, a quality problem (shaky, blurry, dark, rotated, obstructed, low-res), or under 2 s.
values.P: Presenter: a person talking to camera. A real person for testimonial and story beats, never cut in as b-roll.

stream.what: The three production streams, and which tiers each can use.

values.human-only: Cut owned footage straight in: tier A anywhere, tier B inside montage or proof beats, tier P for presenter beats.
values.ai-plus-human: AI scroll stopper (the ruled use of AI) on an owned body cut from tier A and B; or an AI shot generated from a clean owned reference frame.
values.ai-continuous: Every shot generated. The library supplies reference only: clean product frames and settings (text_marks clean).

source.what: Where the file sits on the Shared Drive. The only source signal the records have.

values.creator-raw: content-creators/.../raw or selects: footage a hired creator sent
values.creator-repost: creator folder, but the filename is a downloader or repost (Snaptik, ssstik, SaveInsta, IG_reel, RPReplay, videoplayback)
values.ai: ai-elements, or an archive folder named ai-…
values.ad: intake/ads/<product>/<project> or briefs/delivered/<brief>: a finished ad or the b-roll gathered for that ad (the row's used_in names it)
values.brand-footage: brand-assets: the brand's own shoots and recordings
values.internal: operations, core-avatars, brand-identity: meetings, samples, focus groups, packaging

text_marks.what: What words or marks are burned into the scene. Every mark is shown at selection; none removes a clip (owner ruling 2026-11-06).

values.clean: no on-screen text and no mark noted
values.caption: burned-in words (on_screen_text), not an offer and not a handle
values.offer-text: a code, price, discount or 'shop' line burned in
values.handle: an @handle not on the cleared list (after 6 Nov: only a handle the check pass did not read)
values.partner-handle: a handle cleared to show: the verified partner @Tx3rd_ross, or any handle the check pass read (cleared by owner ruling 2026-11-06)
values.app-screen: a phone app screen, platform UI or status bar noted
values.editor-logo: a CapCut / editor logo or outro noted
values.platform-mark: a TikTok, Instagram, CapCut or YouTube watermark seen by the check pass
values.brand-handle: the brand's own handle (listed in the brand file)

text_marks.text_words: number of words in the scene's on-screen text (0 = none)

people.what: Who is in it. Two sources, kept apart and never mixed.
people.filed: creator_gender, creator_ethnicity, creator_age: the Shared Drive's own filing, content-creators/<gender>/<ethnic-appearance>/<age-band>/<person>/, done by people. It describes the creator who supplied the file; the person on screen can differ (a creator filming a partner).
people.apparent: on_screen_gender and on_screen_age: read from the label's subject line (casting notes). Ethnicity is never read from a picture; the labelling prompt forbids guessing it, and so does this library.

polish.what: How the clip was made, from the check pass (one value per clip). 'unchecked' until the pass reaches it.

values.studio-staged: set, light and framing clearly arranged
values.hucg: high-quality creator footage: deliberate, steady framing, good light, clean background
values.screen-recording: a phone or computer screen captured

product.what: Which brand product is visible. Ids, match words and looks come from the brand file runs/asset-index/<brand>/library/brand-vocabulary.json.

blank.what: The blank a storyboard scene leaves for the library. Every field is a dictionary value; anything left out matches all.
fill_order: 1. Owned cut: tier A (or B in a montage or proof beat, P in a presenter beat) matching beat and product; its text marks are shown.
2. AI with real reference: no owned cut, but clean frames of the product exist (text_marks clean). Generate with the frame attached.
3. [UNFILLED: what it needed]: nothing owned and no clean reference. Shoot it, or leave the hole marked (doctrine §5).
blank.selection: Every query returns a ranked band and a different band and says how many it dropped (doctrine §10).
blank.text: 'any' (default, marks shown), 'clean', or a list of allowed marks
